dialogue_char_tip_main:
JKLI - Move camera (Hold Shift to move 4x faster)
Q/E - Zoom out/in
R - Reset Camera
H - Toggle Speech Bubble
Space - Reset text
dialogue_char_tip_main_mobile:
X - Reset Camera
Y - Toggle Speech Bubble
A - Reset text
dialogue_char_tip_offset:
JKLI - Move camera (Hold Shift to move 4x faster)
Q/E - Zoom out/in
R - Reset Camera
H - Toggle Ghosts
WASD - Move Looping animation offset (Red)
Arrow Keys - Move Idle/Finished animation offset (Blue)
Hold Shift to move offsets 10x faster
dialogue_char_tip_offset_mobile:
X - Reset Camera
Y - Toggle Ghosts
Top Arrow Keys - Move Looping animation offset (Red)
Bottom Arrow Keys - Move Idle/Finished animation offset (Blue)
Hold Z to move offsets 10x faster
